name: Rumble Pro Wrestling: Back For More

appearances.note: Stood ringside for his cousin Tony Antony's match, carrying a comedic prop book.
Interfered on Lance Williams's behalf during the match, without success.
Made an unannounced appearance to call out Chris Chronic and several Rumble Pro wrestlers, promising to appear on the promotion's next show.
Called the color commentary and set the following two shows' own stipulation matches live on air; was called out by name by Terry Brody.
Accompanied her husband, Jonathan Smith, to the ring.
Attacked Travis Cade with a chair after the bell; the beating was broken up by Trevor Rodgers and Justin Kell.
Billed as "Uncle Frank".
Challenged Travis Cade to a singles match on a future show after the win.

matches.stipulation: Qualifying match for the six-man main event
matches.note: Ripper won by chokeout with a rear naked choke and body vice.

matches.stipulation: Qualifying match for the six-man main event
matches.note: Antony scored a surprise rollup win after Valentine's bulldog attempt was blocked.

matches.stipulation: Qualifying match for the six-man main event
matches.note: Gregorson won with a Silver Bullet spear after fighting off Marty Lyons's interference and an Implant DDT on Lyons.

matches.stipulation: Qualifying match for the six-man main event
matches.note: Rodgers won with a double underhook piledriver after Smith kicked out of a Tombstone.

matches.stipulation: Qualifying match for the six-man main event
matches.note: Cade won the match itself; Fenriz then attacked him with a chair afterward and was driven off by Trevor Rodgers and Justin Kell.

matches.stipulation: Qualifying match for the six-man main event
matches.note: Knight stole the pin with a handful of tights and his feet on the ropes.

matches.stipulation: Tornado rules tag team match
matches.note: Van Wild and Scott Starring won with a Starfall Splash into a spear.

matches.stipulation: Six-man scramble match, winner qualifies for the promotion's own first World Title match
matches.note: Trevor Rodgers won with a Diamond Cutter on Tony Antony, joining Justin Kell as the second man set for the World Title match.

notes: The broadcast's own commentary states that Justin Kell, despite losing the opening match, is already slated for the promotion's own first World Title match; Trevor Rodgers's win here makes him the second.

name: Rumble Pro Wrestling: Sole Survivor

date.source: The broadcast's own dateline; the first half of the promotion's own first doubleshot weekend.

notes: Three matches (Van Wild/Scott Starring vs. the Banks Brothers, Cix Killmore's debut win over Andy Sanders, and Gangsta's Heaven's debut win over Paul Wylde and Desmond Clark) are shown only as pre-taped highlight clips from an untelevised "Showcase" card held earlier the same evening; the broadcast itself opens with the first eight-man tag match.

appearances.note: Managed Real Xtreme (Lance Williams and James Robinson) to the ring and announced James Robinson's own arrival from I-X.
Accompanied his cousin Tony Antony to the ring.
Watched the first eight-man tag from ringside, then tripped Teddy Diablo to cost him the match, helping Real Xtreme, Ripper, and Fenriz win.
Cut off Team Xtreme's own mic feed before challenging Lance Williams to a rematch at Leap Year.
Attempted an in-ring promo before the second eight-man tag started; Chris Chronic waved him off and the match proceeded with no entrance for him.
Accompanied Jonathan Smith to the ring.
Billed as "Frank Knight"; sat out most of the match on the apron before eating the pinfall.
Turned on his own tag partner Madison J Valentine late in the match, powerbombing him after Valentine's own Air Valentine, and walked out on his team.
Promotion owner, on commentary throughout; restarted the Kell/Rodgers match for five extra minutes at the crowd's request.
Won an undercard tag match on the untelevised Showcase card with Scott Starring over the Banks Brothers, shown as a highlight clip.
Won his Rumble Pro debut on the untelevised Showcase card, shown as a highlight clip.
Gangsta's Heaven's own debut victims, shown as a highlight clip; Gotti and Hoffa then attacked the tag team Afternoon Delight live at ringside, forcing a lineup change in the first eight-man tag.

matches.note: Shown only as a highlight package from the untelevised Showcase card earlier the same evening; Starring finished with a Starfall Splash.
Killmore's Rumble Pro debut, shown as a Showcase-card highlight package; won with a screwdriver he calls Cix Times the Pain.
Gangsta's Heaven's debut win, shown as a Showcase-card highlight package, finishing with their "86" (a Dominator/top-rope splash combo).

matches.stipulation: eight-man single-fall tag match; the winning team advances to the main event elimination match
matches.note: Ripper pinned Teddy Diablo with the Mother of All Bombs after Trevor Rodgers, seated at ringside, tripped Diablo from the floor for no stated reason.

matches.stipulation: eight-man single-fall tag match; the winning team advances to the main event elimination match
matches.note: Gregorson pinned Madison J Valentine with a Silver Bullet spear after Terry Brody turned on his own partner Valentine, powerbombing him mid-match and walking out.

matches.stipulation: special attraction, singles, fifteen-minute time limit (extended five minutes by fan chant)
matches.note: Billed as a match between two men who had each already qualified for the promotion's own first World Title match; ended in a time-limit draw both times, including a top-rope avalanche twisting backdriver from Kell in the final minute.

matches.stipulation: eight-man elimination tag match; the sole survivor becomes the third man to qualify for the promotion's own first World Title match
matches.note: Eliminations in order: James Robinson (Gregorson, rollup), Werewolf Gregorson (Williams, Brooklyn Bridge assisted by Marty Lyons' brass knuckles), Jonathan Smith (Fenriz and Ripper, double-team reverse bearhug submission), Ben Tuckwell (Ripper, Mother of All Bombs), Lance Williams (Cade, Cavalcade submission), Lark Fenriz (Cade, Golden Gate Bridge pin); Trevor Rodgers then ran in to help Ripper beat down the last man, Travis Cade, letting Ripper finish him with two Mother of All Bombs and claim the sole survivor's spot.

date.source: The broadcast's own dateline; the second half of the promotion's own first doubleshot weekend.

appearances.note: Turned on his own partner Justin Kell mid-match, aligning with Jack Ripper to beat down Lark Fenriz; the match was thrown out.
Cut an in-ring religious promo interrupted by a blindside clothesline from Lark Fenriz, who then powerbombed him off the apron through the timekeeper's table.
Attacked Madison J Valentine from behind before their return match against Tony Antony, then again mid-match; security intervened both times.
Cornered his tag partner Scott Starring backstage before Starring's singles match with Travis Cade.
Won by a tainted backslide, his feet clearly on the ropes and missed by the referee; afterward locked Tuckwell in his own submission hold ("Uncle Frank's Funhouse") until security pulled him off.
Attacked Werewolf Gregorson with his own manager Marty Lyons immediately after Gregorson's win, until security intervened.
Attacked Terry Brody from behind with a chair before the Rumble began, in retaliation for Brody's own earlier attacks.
Cardinal Synn's masked minions interfered on the floor during the Rumble but were not entrants themselves.

matches.stipulation: tag team grudge match
matches.note: No decision: Trevor Rodgers turned on his own partner Justin Kell, aligning with Jack Ripper to beat down Lark Fenriz; the match was ruled a no-contest.

matches.stipulation: return match
matches.note: Valentine won with a top-rope Air Valentine senton after Terry Brody's pre-match attack failed to stop the bout.

matches.stipulation: pure wrestling challenge match, thirty-minute time limit
matches.note: Cade won with a fireman's-carry bridging pin ("Golden Gate Bridge") after twenty minutes of back-and-forth mat wrestling.

matches.stipulation: grudge match
matches.note: Knight won with a backslide, his own feet clearly on the ropes and missed by the referee; Tuckwell later berated Chris Chronic at ringside over the officiating.

matches.stipulation: tryout tag team match
matches.note: South of the Border won by disqualification after the Cum-Shot Feminists kept attacking Hector Guerrero well past the bell, finishing with a stump piledriver off the middle turnbuckle.

matches.stipulation: winner enters the Rumble as the number-one entrant; loser is not in the Rumble
matches.note: Gregorson won with a Silver Bullet spear after Williams's own top-rope powerbomb only got a two-count; James Robinson and Marty Lyons beat Gregorson down after the bell.

matches.stipulation: first-ever Rumble Pro Rumble (over-the-top-rope battle royal, numbered entrants every 90 seconds); the winner becomes the fourth and final man to qualify for the promotion's own first World Title match
matches.note: Twenty numbered entrants, one slot forfeited: Werewolf Gregorson (#1, the qualifying match's own winner), Terry Brody (2), Hoffa (3), "Natural" Lee Handsome (4), Gotti (5), "Total" Lee Awesome (6, whose arrival with Handsome eliminated Gotti and Hoffa together with a double Cactus Clothesline), Lark Fenriz (7), Madison J Valentine (8), Travis Cade (9), Jack Ripper (10), Justin Kell (11), James Robinson (12, eliminating Gregorson), Tony Antony (13), Cix Killmore (14, his Rumble Pro debut), Teddy Diablo (15), Frank Knight (16), a forfeited #17 (nobody entered; the broadcast presumed this was Ben Tuckwell's own slot, Tuckwell having stormed out of the arena earlier that night), Maxis Cendres (18, a Rumble Pro debut of his own), Scott Starring (19), and Trevor Rodgers (20, the final entrant). Travis Cade outlasted all eighteen other actual entrants, shoving Frank Knight to the floor in the final exchange to win.

name: Rumble Pro Wrestling: Initiation Rites
notes: A one-night, nine-team single-elimination tournament crowning the promotion's own first Tag Team Champions, plus a four-corners number-one contender's match and a grudge match. A video package early in the broadcast confirms Justin Kell won the promotion's own first World Title match on 28 March 2004; no primary-source transcript of that show survives in the held record.

appearances.note: Crotched Madison J Valentine on the top rope during the first quarterfinal, costing Valentine and Antony the fall.
Ran in with Hate and Anger to cost Gregorson and LaGrange their quarterfinal by disqualification, then beat both men down afterward.
Directed Hate, Anger, and Lucifer Magnusson through repeated interference across the show, including a triple powerbomb of Trevor Rodgers through a table.
Attacked Real Xtreme unprovoked after their semifinal win, then was beaten down by them and Marty Lyons before security separated them.
Named himself special guest referee for the tournament final, barring Marty Lyons and threatening to fire anyone else who interfered.

matches.stipulation: tag team title tournament quarterfinal, three-team elimination (two falls scored)
matches.note: The Cum-Shot Feminists were eliminated first (Kell pinned Chuck with a Delirium Trigger DDT); Rodgers then pinned Valentine with a top-rope Diamond Cutter after Terry Brody crotched Valentine on the top rope, eliminating Valentine and Antony and sending Rodgers and Kell to the semifinals.

matches.stipulation: tag team title tournament quarterfinal
matches.note: Won by disqualification when Lucifer Magnusson ran in to break up LaGrange's own Texas Cloverleaf submission on Anger; the Hatebreed then beat both LaGrange and Gregorson down after the bell.

matches.stipulation: tag team title tournament quarterfinal
matches.note: Real Xtreme won when Robinson bridged a rollup on Lee Awesome ("Total") for the pin, Marty Lyons interfering at ringside throughout.

matches.stipulation: tag team title tournament quarterfinal
matches.note: Wild and Starring won when Gotti, distracted after climbing to the top rope for a Doomsday Device, was shoved off by a recovering Starring, letting Wild finish Hoffa with a victory roll.

matches.stipulation: grudge match, fifteen-minute time limit
matches.note: Valentine won with a second Silver Bullet superkick after a long, physical match; the two shook hands afterward.

matches.stipulation: tag team title tournament semifinal
matches.note: Gregorson pinned Rodgers with a Silver Bullet spear after Rodgers had rolled up Gregorson for what looked like the pin moments before.

matches.stipulation: tag team title tournament semifinal
matches.note: Real Xtreme won after Marty Lyons knocked Scott Starring out cold with a chain-assisted punch behind the referee's back; Cix Killmore attacked Real Xtreme unprovoked immediately afterward.

matches.stipulation: four-corners, one-fall match for the number-one contendership to the Rumble Pro World Heavyweight Championship, forty-five-minute time limit
matches.note: Jack Ripper brawled Justin Kell (at ringside to watch) into the crowd for most of the match; the Hatebreed (Cardinal Synn, Lucifer Magnusson, Hate, and Anger) repeatedly interfered against Cade and Rodgers, including a triple powerbomb of Rodgers through a table, letting Fenriz pin Cade with a spinning cradle piledriver. Ripper then beat Kell bloody at ringside, choked him out with his own World Title belt, and the Hatebreed piled on with Fenriz to leave both Kell and Rodgers laid out.

matches.stipulation: tag team title tournament final, for the vacant and inaugural Rumble Pro Tag Team Championship, no time limit; Chris Chronic as special guest referee
matches.note: Real Xtreme won the promotion's own first Tag Team Championship when Robinson hit a top-rope spike piledriver on Gregorson after Williams had knocked LaGrange off the apron. LaGrange returned moments later with his branding iron, blasting a fireball into Marty Lyons' face.

name: Rumble Pro Wrestling: Absolute Power

date.source: The broadcast's own dateline; posted in two parts.

notes: A two-part broadcast transcript, posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy in two separate messages; each part is served as its own page under this wing's archive. Opens with a worked "XTREME TV" talk-show segment (Marty Lyons) recapping Travis LaGrange's own branding-iron and fireball angles and issuing a challenge for a rematch, itself not a match.

appearances.note: Hosted a worked talk-show segment recapping Travis LaGrange's own attacks on Real Xtreme and issuing a challenge for a branding-iron rematch outside Minnesota at Apocalypse Now.
Sidelined with an in-fiction injury, not in action this broadcast.
Cut a confused backstage promo naming the wrong opponent before wrestling Cix Killmore.
Named on commentary as too unwilling to wrestle Hell's Angels in the Ultraviolent match, leaving the spot to Debonair as a favor to Chris Chronic.

matches.stipulation: Rumble Pro Gauntlet, match 1 (six drawn entrants, ten-minute limit per bout until the final, unlimited bout)
matches.note: Cade won by submission (an Ohio Cloverleaf variant).

matches.stipulation: Rumble Pro Gauntlet, match 2
matches.note: Cade won by submission again.

matches.stipulation: Rumble Pro Gauntlet, match 3
matches.note: Ruled a time-limit draw; per the gauntlet's own rules both men were eliminated together, and the next two drawn entrants faced off fresh.

matches.stipulation: Rumble Pro Gauntlet, match 4 (no time limit)
matches.note: Wild won the gauntlet outright with an airplane-spin Diamond Cutter ("Wild Ride").

matches.stipulation: Rumble Pro Strong Style Cup, first round (winnable only by submission, disqualification, or a ten-count knockdown)
matches.note: Ruled a double draw: neither man answered referee Jason Bach's ten count in time.

matches.stipulation: Rumble Pro Strong Style Cup, first round; Chris Chronic decreed every qualifier tonight must produce a winner
matches.note: Williams won by submission.

matches.stipulation: Rumble Pro Strong Style Cup, first round
matches.note: Knight won by submission.

matches.stipulation: Rumble Pro Strong Style Cup, first round; a mutual-respect handshake opened the match between tag partners
matches.note: Gregorson was declared the "survivor" moving on in the tournament; both men shook hands after.

matches.stipulation: tag team battle royal; the winning team earns the next Tag Team Championship shot against Real Xtreme
matches.note: Four teams, last-team-standing rules. Afternoon Delight eliminated first, then Gangsta's Heaven; the Cum-Shot Feminists survived Gregorson and LaGrange's own team when Chuck's foot barely stayed on the apron as both he and Donovan appeared to have gone over together with Gregorson.

matches.stipulation: special challenge match
matches.note: Valentine won with a reverse Ace Crusher ("Cupid Cutter") into a top-rope Air Valentine; the two shook hands afterward.

matches.stipulation: tag team Ultraviolent match (tables, chairs, a barbed-wire board, and a ladder-suspended barbed-wire bat at ringside; Debonair filled in for a Jack Ripper who declined the booking)
matches.note: Hell's Angels won after a barbed-wire-board powerbomb; Debonair (billed as old independent-circuit friends of Chris Chronic's) took a one-sided beating throughout.

matches.stipulation: for the Rumble Pro World Heavyweight Championship, sixty-minute time limit
matches.note: Kell retained, rolling Fenriz up for the pin the instant a fresh referee (Jason Bach) slid in to replace a chair-shot Hector Ortega; the Hatebreed then beat both Kell and Fenriz down until Travis Cade and Van Wild made the save.

name: Rumble Pro Wrestling: Apocalypse Now

date.source: The broadcast's own dateline; the show bills itself in its own text as "Apocalypse Now".

notes: This document's own served page and filename read "Absolute Power (May 29)", matching the prior show's own title, but the broadcast's own text bills itself throughout as "Rumble Pro Presents Apocalypse Now", and a Rumble Pro schedule graphic on the prior show independently names 29 May as Apocalypse Now; the show record here uses the broadcast's own in-fiction name. Also includes a six-man exhibition trading on wrestlers from other, mostly unheld promotions (NEO-Pro, IGA, WILD) previewing a future cross-promotion tournament; four of its six wrestlers (Ktulu; Jeff Keenan and Steve Greedy, both homed at the held dwf-motr wing; Sammy Griffin, homed at the held kawf wing) are RSPWF Top 200 stubs, each gaining a further tenure here rather than a fresh mint.

appearances.note: Switched places with Hate mid-match, unnoticed by Giuseppe Valentine, and hit a chokeslam before Hate switched back in.
Distracted referee Hector Ortega from ringside during Fenriz/Gregorson, helping Fenriz win.
Ran in with a chair to attack both teams during the tag title match, causing the no-contest, in revenge for Real Xtreme's own distraction earlier in the night and their branding of Travis LaGrange.

matches.stipulation: Rumble Pro Gauntlet, match 1; the gauntlet's own winner becomes the fourth man in tonight's main event
matches.note: Ridge's Rumble Pro debut win, by a Ki-Krusher-style "Ridged Rupture".

matches.stipulation: Rumble Pro Gauntlet, match 2
matches.note: Ridge won by disqualification after the masked Mania attacked referee Hector Ortega; Mania then chair-busted Ridge open and mist-blinded a security guard before being hauled backstage.

matches.stipulation: Rumble Pro Gauntlet, match 3
matches.note: Giuseppe Valentine's Rumble Pro debut win, choking out a badly bleeding Ridge with a sleeper.

matches.stipulation: Rumble Pro Gauntlet, match 4
matches.note: Valentine won quickly with a bridging German suplex.

matches.stipulation: Rumble Pro Gauntlet, match 5 (no time limit); the gauntlet's winner becomes the fourth man in tonight's main event
matches.note: Valentine won the gauntlet outright with a rollup, grabbing the ropes for leverage, after Cardinal Synn's own Hate-and-Anger switch failed to put him away.

matches.stipulation: six-man preview exhibition for the promotion's own forthcoming Rumble Pro Invitational tournament
matches.note: Steve Greedy pinned Jamie Roberts with a DDT after Ktulu turned on his own team (a sitout tombstone piledriver on Keenan) and walked out.

matches.stipulation: Rumble Pro Strong Style Cup quarterfinal, three-way elimination (submission, ten-count knockdown, or disqualification only)
matches.note: Tuckwell was counted out first, ten minutes in, after Magnusson's own Catalepsy Driver/Divine Intoxication combination; Magnusson then out-lasted Cade's own triple German suplex flurry to knock him out cold with a second Catalepsy Driver, advancing.

matches.stipulation: Rumble Pro Strong Style Cup quarterfinal
Rumble Pro Strong Style Cup quarterfinal
matches.note: Fenriz won after Real Xtreme (Lance Williams and James Robinson) distracted the referee from ringside.

matches.stipulation: impromptu non-title match
matches.note: Kell, not himself booked, wrestled anyway and won with a top-turnbuckle powerbomb ("Fighting Gravity") after Cardinal Synn's distraction nearly cost him; the Hatebreed beat him down afterward regardless.

matches.stipulation: for the Rumble Pro Tag Team Championship
matches.note: No decision: Werewolf Gregorson ran in with a steel chair and laid out both teams; Real Xtreme retained by the resulting no-contest ruling.

matches.stipulation: main event, four-corners one-fall match for the number-one contendership to Justin Kell's World Heavyweight Championship (the shot to be paid off on night two of the forthcoming Rumble Pro Invitational)
matches.note: Wild pinned Giuseppe Valentine with an airplane-spin Diamond Cutter ("Wild Ride") after Antony and Brody had eliminated each other's offense; Brody nearly broke up the cover but was a beat too late.
